SELECT id AS id, create_by AS create_by, create_time AS create_time, update_by AS update_by, update_time AS update_time,
currency_number AS currency_number, currency_name AS currency_name, amount_precision AS amount_precision, price_precision AS price_precision, description AS description, currency_sign AS currency_sign, enable_flag AS enable_flag FROM sys_md_base_currency WHERE deleted = 0
AND currency_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.currencyNumber}, '%')
AND currency_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.currencyName}, '%')
AND amount_precision LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.amountPrecision}, '%')
AND price_precision LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.pricePrecision}, '%')
AND description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.description}, '%')
AND currency_sign LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vo.currencySign}, '%')
AND enable_flag = #{vo.enableFlag}
